records.title: Intensive Estonian
records.text: ESTO 150 Intensive Estonian (15) Fundamentals of oral and written Estonian. Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing Estonian. Interactive classroom, computer-assisted learning, language, and reading laboratories. Emphasis on contemporary Estonian culture and society.
